What a plan actually unlocks, so your product can ask the billing system instead of keeping its own copy of who bought what. A **feature** is a switch, a quota or a meter; attaching one to a product grants it to every subscription of that product.

A subscription's effective entitlements are the plan's grants **overlaid with any overrides set on that subscription**, so a one-off arrangement for a single customer does not need a private plan. `check` answers the runtime question — is this subscription entitled, and to how much.

## Endpoints

| Method | Endpoint | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/features`](/help/developers/api-reference/entitlements/list-features) | List features |
| `POST` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/features`](/help/developers/api-reference/entitlements/create-a-feature) | Create a feature |
| `GET` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/features/{feature}`](/help/developers/api-reference/entitlements/get-a-feature) | Get a feature |
| `PATCH` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/features/{feature}`](/help/developers/api-reference/entitlements/edit-a-feature-s-name) | Edit a feature's name, unit or description |
| `DELETE` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/features/{feature}`](/help/developers/api-reference/entitlements/archive-a-feature) | Archive a feature |
| `POST` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/features/{feature}/archive`](/help/developers/api-reference/entitlements/archive-a-feature-2) | Archive a feature |
| `POST` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/features/{feature}/reactivate`](/help/developers/api-reference/entitlements/reactivate-an-archived-feature) | Reactivate an archived feature |
| `GET` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/products/{prod}/entitlements`](/help/developers/api-reference/entitlements/list-a-product-s-plan-entitlements) | List a product's plan entitlements |
| `POST` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/products/{prod}/entitlements`](/help/developers/api-reference/entitlements/attach-a-feature-to-a-product) | Attach a feature to a product (plan) with a granted value |
| `GET` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/subscriptions/{sub}/entitlements`](/help/developers/api-reference/entitlements/effective-entitlements-for-a-subscription) | Effective entitlements for a subscription |
| `POST` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/subscriptions/{sub}/entitlements`](/help/developers/api-reference/entitlements/override-a-feature-value-for-one-subscription) | Override a feature value for one subscription |
| `GET` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/subscriptions/{sub}/entitlements/{key}/check`](/help/developers/api-reference/entitlements/check-entitlement-for-a-subscription) | Check entitlement for a subscription |
